title: feat(spec)!: oauth2 and app-credential connector instance auth; the runtime oauth2 variant retired (ADR-0143 S0)
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibwb6hBqszPTYJobitm

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao4xopuwRpgz7BBJKw6iZpKi)_

Fixes #28137

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #28226

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:连接器实例的 `auth` 新增两种需要换取令牌的类型,`oauth2`(授权码 / 客户端凭证)和 `app-credential`(飞书、钉钉、企业微信),密钥只能写引用;旧的运行时 `oauth2` 写法被移除并给出改写提示。
- 为什么改:以前对接要 OAuth 的系统在开源版里无处声明,旧写法把密钥和刷新令牌明文写进配置,也从来没人执行;ADR-0143 把这类认证纳入开源层,这是第一步(只定形状)。
- 风险与回滚:写了 `authentication: { type: 'oauth2' }` 的连接器会被拒绝(有迁移提示);新类型的实例在服务端真正支持前一律标为"降级、不调用上游",数据源借用返回 422,不会出现未认证调用。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/shared/connector-auth.zod.ts`(新形状与拒绝提示)和 `packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts` 里新加的降级分支。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/integration/connector-auth-grant-kinds.test.ts src/shared/connector-auth.test.ts`,看到每个拒绝都有错误码和位置、每种类型都有正例通过。
- 需要你做的：无。不属于受管面，契约复审 PASS（评论 6529303069），由席位落地；技能文档与 lint 提示的更新已立卡 #28226，随 S1 落地。

## What changes

**`@objectstack/spec`**

- `ConnectorInstanceAuthSchema` gains two members (ADR-0143 D2.1, D2.2). Both are closed (`strictObject`), and both carry their secret only as `credentialRef`.
  - `oauth2` is a union on `grant`, one strict shape per grant.
    - `authorization_code` takes `authorizationUrl`, `tokenUrl`, `scopes`, `resource`, `clientId` and an optional `credentialRef` (a public client has no secret).
    - `client_credentials` has no `authorizationUrl` key, and its `credentialRef` is required.
    - Both use the projectable `dependentRequired` refinement, so the JSON Schema carries the rule and no dropped-refinements entry is owed.
  - `app-credential` takes `vendor` (`feishu` | `dingtalk` | `wecom`), `appId` and a required `credentialRef`.
  - An inline secret or token key is refused by name with the `credentialRef` prescription: `clientSecret`, `secret`, `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, `token` and `pkce` on `oauth2`; `appSecret`, `secret`, `corpSecret`, `accessToken` and `token` on `app-credential`. The aliases `audience` → `resource` and `appKey` / `corpId` / `clientId` → `appId` answer with the right key.
  - ⛔ There is no `signed` member (#26710, D2.3).
- On `DeclarativeConnectorEntrySchema` (both authoring doors), an `oauth2` instance must name `tokenUrl` and `clientId`, plus `authorizationUrl` on `authorization_code`. Each missing key is refused at `auth.<key>`. The one exception is `provider: 'mcp'` over an `http` transport, where the MCP authorization flow discovers the endpoints and can register the client. An mcp instance over stdio gets the same refusals as any other instance.
- **D7.** `ConnectorOAuth2Schema` leaves `ConnectorAuthConfigSchema`.
  - `authentication: { type: 'oauth2' }` is refused at `type` with a prescription that names ADR-0143 D7 and the instance `auth` that replaces it. The union's error map fires only for that literal, the `ViewDataSchema` `provider: 'api'` precedent.
  - `ResolvedConnectorAuth` stays the four static kinds.
  - The schema was module-level only and never on a published entry point. The type it narrows, `integration/Connector:authentication`, is authorable, hence the narrowing line.
  - The ADR-0087 D3 entry `connector-auth-config-oauth2-retired` records the change, with its `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment (order 115).
- **D4.** The per-dispatch handle types move into `packages/spec/src/integration/connector-provider.ts`: `ConnectorCredentialHandle`, `BorrowedConnectorCredential`, `BorrowedConnectorAuth` and `ConnectorCredentialRequest`, structurally identical. `ConnectorProviderContext` gains `readonly credentialHandle?: ConnectorCredentialHandle`.
- **Token-endpoint client authentication** (card item 4) has no key. The ADR leaves the method (`client_secret_basic` vs `client_secret_post`) to the runtime that calls the token endpoint, so S1 owns it. The seat accepted this as an S1 choice.
- The header text "OAuth2 is intentionally absent" is rewritten to the open-tier reading. The six new isomorphic aliases are pinned in `type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts` (count 795 → 801, with its receipt).

**`@objectstack/types`**: `connector-credential-source.ts` re-exports the four handle types from `@objectstack/spec/integration` under the same names. The service-datasource typecheck and its 1069 tests are unchanged and green.

**`@objectstack/service-automation`** (seat ruling A). Widening the union made two switches non-exhaustive, so the minimal exhaustive handling is:
- `plugin.ts`: an `oauth2` or `app-credential` instance is held **degraded** through the existing `failDegradedConnectorInstance` path, with a reason that names its kind. Its factory is never called, so it never reaches the upstream unauthenticated.
- `connector-credential-source.ts`: a datasource borrow of such an instance is refused with `422 VALIDATION_ERROR`, naming the kind and the instance.

**Docs and fixtures**
- `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx`: "Where is `oauth2`?" is replaced by "Grant-bearing kinds: `oauth2` and `app-credential`", plus a note on the retired runtime variant and a failure-modes row.
- `packages/spec/docs/SYNC_ARCHITECTURE.md`: the L3 example moves off the retired variant. The auth table drops `jwt` and `saml`, which were never variants.
- `variant-docs.json`: re-keyed for the three unions.
- The frozen fixture `packages/qa/downstream-contract` `DcConnector` changes per its README, because the break is intended and documented here: `authentication` is now `bearer`, with a comment citing the D7 entry.

## S1 replaces these lines

These are the stand-in lines S1 (#26702) replaces when per-dispatch resolution lands. Every one of them is in `packages/services/service-automation/src/`:

- `plugin.ts`, the `GrantBearingInstanceAuth` type and `grantBearingNotServedReason()` (lines 402–417 at head).
- `plugin.ts`, the narrowed `resolveInstanceAuth(auth: Exclude<ConnectorInstanceAuth, GrantBearingInstanceAuth> | undefined, …)` signature and its doc sentence "A grant-bearing kind never reaches here either…" (lines 424–431).
- `plugin.ts`, the reconcile branch `if (entry.auth?.type === 'oauth2' || entry.auth?.type === 'app-credential') { this.failDegradedConnectorInstance(…); continue; }` with its three-line comment (lines 2269–2283).
- `connector-credential-source.ts`, `Lendable.auth: Exclude<ConnectorInstanceAuth, { type: 'none' | 'oauth2' | 'app-credential' }>` (line 84).
- `connector-credential-source.ts`, the `lendRefusal` branch `if (auth.type === 'oauth2' || auth.type === 'app-credential') { return … }` with its comment (lines 118–126).
- The tests that pin the stand-in: `connector-materialization.test.ts` describe "ADR-0143 D4 — a grant-bearing instance is held degraded…", and `connector-credential-source.test.ts` describe "[ADR-0143 D4] createConnectorCredentialSource — a grant-bearing kind is refused, not lent". Their CONTROL cases for the four static kinds stay.
- `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx`: the "A server that does not yet run the per-dispatch token resolution…" paragraph and the failure-modes row for a grant-bearing kind.

What S1 needs that this slice leaves out:
- A provider that reads `ConnectorProviderContext.credentialHandle`. The member is typed here and nothing sets it yet.
- The token-endpoint client-auth method choice (basic vs post).
- The connection record that holds an `authorization_code` grant.
- The mcp `client_credentials` path through dynamic client registration, when `clientId` is omitted.
- The skill bullet named under `Skills-docs:` above.

## Deviations from the dispatch order

- The order said "Do not touch server packages". Widening `ConnectorInstanceAuth` turned the service-automation typecheck red (6 errors), so I reported it to the seat. The seat ruled **A**: touch only `connector-credential-source.ts` and `plugin.ts`, minimal and exhaustive, as above.
- The order's lines were `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: added`. D7 removes an authorable value (`integration/Connector:authentication` `type: 'oauth2'`), so the seat ruled `yes (narrowing)` / `narrowed`, with a BREAKING changeset and the registered ADR-0087 entry. The lines are corrected here and in the changeset.
- Beyond the expected landing, these files changed on the producer side: `integration/connector.zod.ts` (the entry rule and re-exports), `shared/connector-auth.test.ts` and `integration/connector.test.ts` (retired-variant tests), `type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts` (ADR-0122 gate), `variant-docs.json`, `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx`, `packages/spec/docs/SYNC_ARCHITECTURE.md` (its L3 example is compiled by `connector-author-shape.test.ts`) and the qa fixture.

## Verification

Head `4d12a2786bc03dfb6d046d7a31f9761cec235616` (includes a merge of `origin/main`).

**Tests**

| Command | Result |
|:---|:---|
| `vitest run src/integration src/shared src/migrations src/type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts` (spec) | 54 files, 1335 tests, green |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` (incl. test layer) | exit 0 |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/types typecheck && test` | exit 0 · 825/825 |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation typecheck && test` | exit 0 · 2926/2926 (merged head) |

| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/downstream-contract typecheck` + `test/contract.test.ts` | exit 0 · 13/13 |

`consumer-specifier-ledger.test.ts` refuses locally because `@objectstack/cli` has no dist in this box. That is a prerequisite refusal, not a finding, and CI builds it.

**Gates.** `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 109 commands. I ran each one with `</dev/null` and recorded `<command> :: exit <code>` on disk. All 109 exit 0.

`--ran` reconciliation: "109 derived, 109 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". Four commands first refused for local reasons and were re-run green:
- `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`, on a shallow clone, after fetching its pinned commit.
- The `.d.ts`-reading spec gates, against a stale dist after the rebase, after a rebuild.
- `check:skill-examples`, with no client-react dist, after building it.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, with no package dists, after a packages build.

One real finding, `check:spec-parsed-alias` (ADR-0122, 6 new aliases), is fixed by the pins. `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main`: OK.

**Ablations.** I used `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Each mutation landed (anchor 1 → 0) and was restored (blob == HEAD):
- A1, the mcp-http exception removed: 3 red in `connector-auth-grant-kinds.test.ts`, the two mcp CONTROLs and the secret-without-client-id case.
- A2, the D7 prescription removed: 2 red in `connector-auth.test.ts`.
- A3, `client_credentials` no longer requiring `credentialRef`: 1 red.
- A4, the `plugin.ts` degrade branch disabled: 2 red in `connector-materialization.test.ts`, one per kind.
- A5, the lend refusal disabled: 2 red in `connector-credential-source.test.ts`, one per kind.

**Dogfood battery.** Full `@objectstack/dogfood` on the final head `4d12a2786`, run under `os-verify-lock` as 6 vitest shards, each `VERDICT command-exit 0`. Result: Test Files 359 passed, 3 skipped (362). Tests 2891 passed, 20 skipped (2911). No failures. It was also green on the pre-merge head `4609d0cb6`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Located errors.** Every refusal is pinned by `code @ path`. Each of the two members has a CONTROL accept, and so does `provider: 'mcp'` on http with the endpoints and `clientId` omitted (`connector-auth-grant-kinds.test.ts`):
  - a missing endpoint: `custom @ auth.tokenUrl` / `auth.clientId` / `auth.authorizationUrl`
  - an unknown grant: `invalid_union @ auth.grant`
  - an inline secret, token or `pkce`: `unrecognized_keys @ auth` with the key named
  - `credentialRef` without `clientId`, or `client_credentials` without a secret: `custom @ auth.credentialRef`
  - an unknown vendor: `invalid_value @ auth.vendor`
  - a missing app secret reference: `invalid_type @ auth.credentialRef`
  - `signed` / `oauth1`: `invalid_union @ type`
- An inline secret is refused on both new members (ADR Acceptance).
- `ResolvedConnectorAuth` is unchanged (four static kinds). `@objectstack/types` keeps re-exporting the moved handle types, and the datasource borrow path's importers typecheck and test green.
- The changeset is `.changeset/28137-connector-grant-bearing-auth.md`: BREAKING, with `<!-- adr-0087: registered connector-auth-config-oauth2-retired -->`. `check-adr-0087-registration` and `check-changeset-no-major` are green.
- A contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is owed before the queue. The triage seat runs it.
